svg.title: keyguard: five layers between your keyboard and GitHub
svg.desc: A thin crawler, small glowing dots joined by hairlines, climbs a rising track from KEYBOARD through COMMIT and PUSH to GITHUB. Gates stand on the track, in this order: L2 AI-agent guard, L1 pre-commit, L1 reference-transaction, L1 pre-push, L3 GitHub scanning, L5 publish check and L4 crawler. L1 is three git hooks, so it has three gates. Six gates stamp a masked API key BLOCKED (the AI-agent guard blocks the command that would let a key through); the crawler finds keys already on GitHub and stamps them FOUND. A magenta tag marks the gates that ignore git --no-verify; an outline tag marks the two it skips. Two more crawlers hang off the track: one at the GitHub end reaches the two layers that scan GitHub and has two more masked keys in its sights, one under KEYBOARD has a masked key of its own in its sights.
